style.backgroundSystem: flat mica white #F6F9FA field for packshot and spec screens, turquoise aqua #4EB4BE colour block for benefit and close fields, deep ink-teal #173B45 block wall for the pain-point grid; no photographic skies, no water surfaces
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #173B45 inside hairline rings, one blank sun-ring medallion with no numerals
style.lightingSystem: hard neutral midday daylight from the upper right, crisp solar shadow edges, single soft bounce fill on the product face, about 5600K, no glow bloom and no lens flare
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sunlit mineral-terrace skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mica white #F6F9FA, turquoise aqua #4EB4BE, sun-orange accent #F0A63C and deep ink-teal text #173B45; neutral daylight grading; matte lime-stone and plaster riser blocks with a fine mineral grain; hard midday light from the upper right with crisp solar shadow edges and one soft bounce fill; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline plus short blank lozenge labels; thin single-weight line icons inside hairline rings; blank sun-ring medallion with no numerals; stable upright product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no water or ice motifs, no invented ratings or numerals.
noDrift: no color palette changes outside #F6F9FA, #4EB4BE, #F0A63C and #173B45
no water, ripple, splash, mist, ice or pearl motifs
no mixed fonts, no script or handwritten lettering
no protection-factor numerals, plus signs, star ratings, lab figures or seal artwork
no random backgrounds and no soft bloom lighting that breaks the hard solar shadow
style.presentationRules: upright pack, stable slight angle and identical product scale across every screen; props and hands never cover the label face
style.surfaceSystem: matte lime-stone and plaster riser blocks in #F6F9FA with a fine mineral grain, dry stucco edges, no glossy mirror plates
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one headline plus short blank lozenge labels, no dense body paragraphs
